{{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Fighting |type2=Steel |trainername=Roy |pokemonname=Lucario |jtrainername=ロイ |jpokemonname=ルカリオ |tmtrainername=Roy |tmpokemonname=Lucario |shiny=yes |image=[[File:Roy Lucario.png|x140px]] |caption=Roy's Lucario {{shinystar}} |gender=Unknown |location=[[Lost Mayo Maze]] |prevonum=0448 s |noevo=incap |epnum=HZ089 |epname=Where the Adventure Leads |catchepnum=HZ114 |catchepname=Mega Evolution - Bonds |catchepnametiming=In a flashback in |current=[[Party|With]] [[Roy]] |java1=[[Taku Yashiro]] |enva1=[[Bill Rogers]][https://x.com/billsvoice/status/2015420396124934432 Bill Rogers twitter]. }} '''Roy's Lucario''' (Japanese: '''ロイのルカリオ''' ''Roy's Lucario''), also known as the (Japanese: '''黄色いルカリオ''' ''Yellow Lucario'') and '''Yellow Flash''' (Japanese: '''イエローブラスト''' ''Yellow Blast''), is the first Pokémon [[Roy]] caught in the [[Kalos|Kalos region]] and his third overall. It is a [[Shiny Pokémon]]. ==History== [[File:Lucario choosing Roy.png|thumb|250px|left|Lucario choosing to go with [[Roy]]]] As revealed in ''[[HZ112|Mega Evolution - Roy]]'', {{p|Lucario}}, known as the "Yellow Flash" at the time, was considered to be the strongest Pokémon living at the [[Lost Mayo Maze]] in the [[Kalos]] [[region]], always looking out for opponents at its level. After the incident in [[Laqua]], [[Master Mayonnaise]] tasked [[Roy]] and [[Ult]] to find the palace and challenge the Yellow Flash as part of their [[Mega Evolution]] training. However, after making their way there, both of them were easily defeated by Lucario due to its speed. In the [[HZ113|next episode]], Lucario led Roy and Ult back to its lair, giving the two {{pkmn|Trainer}}s a chance for a [[rematch]]. In ''[[HZ114|Mega Evolution - Bonds]]'', Lucario battled both Roy and Ult once more. Although Ult Mega Evolved his {{p|Sableye}}, due to its inexperience with Mega Evolution, Lucario still managed to defeat it, with {{TP|Roy|Crocalor}} being the only one left to battle. Despite the odds, thanks to Roy's singing and predictions, Crocalor was able to avoid Lucario's attacks and counter its speed. Upon sensing Roy's [[aura]], Lucario was so motivated that it somehow Mega Evolved even though Roy had not {{pkmn2|caught}} it yet. Mega Lucario then attacked Crocalor with Flash Cannon, but it was ultimately defeated by Crocalor's {{m|Flamethrower}}. Inspired by both Roy and Crocalor's strength, Lucario begged Roy to let it join his team, after which Roy caught Lucario as his third Pokemon. [[File:Roy and Lucario.png|thumb|250px|Lucario and Roy]] Lucario debuted at the very end of ''[[HZ089|Where the Adventure Leads]]'', where it was seen alongside [[Roy]] and the rest of his [[Party|team]] one year after incident in Laqua. In ''[[HZ090|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part One)]]'', Lucario was used to battle against a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Slaking}} that was being influenced by [[Laquium]]. It immediately [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] alongside [[Ult]]'s {{p|Sableye}}, allowing them to weaken their opponent enough for [[Captain Pikachu]] to finish it off. In the [[HZ091|next episode]], Lucario went up against [[Ann]]'s {{p|Samurott}} and quickly won without Mega Evolving. In ''[[HZ101|Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!]]'', Lucario teamed up with Crocalor for a [[Double Battle]] against {{an|Nemona}}'s {{p|Pawmot}} and {{p|Ribombee}}. They initially struggled against their opponents, as their defined roles as attacker and support, respectively, allowed them to deal big damage and remain healthy through most of the battle. Once Roy managed to disrupt it, however, they were able to launch a strong counterattack. Soon, Lucario Mega Evolved while Pawmot {{Tera}}stallized, and the ensuing clash of {{t|Fighting}} [[type]]s ended up with Lucario's victory, thus making Roy win by default. [[File:Roy Lucario Lucarionite.png|thumb|250px|left|Lucario's [[Lucarionite]]]] In ''[[HZ107|Friends as Two, Me and You]]'', Lucario, alongside the rest of Roy's party and Ult's Sableye, battled against [[Indi]] and [[Rubina]]'s {{form|Darmanitan|Zen Mode}} {{p|Darmanitan}}. Due to the [[Explorers]] being assisted by an army of {{p|Rabsca}}, they managed to keep the upper hand for the majority of the battle. However, once Ult's {{p|Dragonite}} emerged, Mega Evolved, and defeated the Rabsca, Lucario was able to Mega Evolve before teaming up with Mega Dragonite to deal the finishing blow, defeating the two Darminitan. In ''[[HZ110|The Six Heroes Unleashed!]]'', Lucario was used alongside the rest of Roy, [[Liko]], and Ult's Pokémon to battle against five of the [[Six Heroes]], who were under the influence of the Super [[Strong Sphere]]s. Together, they stalled for time to allow Pagogo to purify the Laquium away from the heroes' bodies, only for the Explorers to use the Super Strong Spheres on them a second time. In the [[HZ111|next episode]], after being Mega Evolved, Lucario teamed up with Ult's Mega Dragonite to take on {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}} and {{TP|Lucius|Lapras}}. They performed a combination tactic that temporarily stunned their opponents, but before they could follow up with an actual attack, Lucario and Dragonite were simultaneously taken out by {{TP|Lucius|Arboliva}}. In ''[[HZ115|Welcome to Blueberry Academy!]]'', Lucario and Crocalor were sent out for a Double Battle against Nemona's Pawmot and {{p|Decidueye}}. However, despite its efforts, Lucario was defeated when Decidueye used {{m|Spirit Shackle}} to stop it from moving, as Crocalor was also defeated after it was, losing the battle. In [[HZ124]], Lucario teamed up with Ult's Sableye and Captain Pikachu to help Roy, Ult, [[Amethio]], and the girls save the remaining Six Heroes from the Explorers, as they battle the grunts. Despite defeating the three grunts, Lucario was left in no shape to continue the mission. In [[HZ127]], Lucario battled Nemona's Pawmot once again. After a tough fight, Lucario Mega Evolve while Pawmot Terastallized, with both Pokémon clashing attacks with each other. In the end, Lucario was defeated once again after Pawmot dodged its final attack at the last moment and the Hands-On Pokémon used {{m|Mach Punch}}. [[File:Lucarionite Z anime.png|thumb|250px|Lucario's [[Lucarionite Z]]]] In [[HZ129]], Lucario was sent out as Roy's second Pokémon during his battle against the [[Black Rayquaza]], fighting it alongside Ult's Mega Dragonite in its own Mega-Evolved form. Lucario even defended Dragonite from Rayquaza's Draco Meteor to help its teammate last longer in the fight. Despite landing some strong hits, Lucario was ultimately defeated by a powerful combination of Rayquaza's {{m|Dragon Ascent}} and {{m|Dragon Pulse}}. In [[HZ131]], Lucario received a [[Lucarionite Z]] from Master Mayonnaise and then proceeded to have a battle against his {{p|Hawlucha}}. Initially, they appeared to be equally matched, but once Hawlucha Mega Evolved, it dominated the battle and turned Lucario's offensive battle style against it with an {{m|Encore}}. Having fallen out of sync with its Trainer, Lucario was unable to achieve the new Mega Evolution and soon fell to a {{m|Flying Press}}. Master Mayonnaise pointed out that Lucario still needed to master its true aura power, and they agreed to train. In the [[HZ132|next episode]], following an unfruitful training session, Lucario unwound and sung with its Trainer and teammates, which gave to it a new perspective during its [[rematch]] against Mega Hawlucha. Now, even under the effect of Encore, it was able to adopt a more relaxed, free-flowing battle style, allowing it to block and dodge the incoming assault all the while waiting for the perfect moment to counterattack. With Lucario and Roy becoming more in sync as the battle went on, it successfully Mega Evolved into Mega Lucario Z for the first time and, after learning {{m|Aerial Ace}}, finished off Hawlucha, winning Roy the rematch. In [[HZ133]], Lucario Mega Evolved into Mega Lucario Z and was used to battle [[Chalce]]'s Mega {{p|Medicham}}. The battle continued in the [[HZ134|next episode]], where Lucario's arms got frozen by [[Coral]]'s {{p|Glalie}}, Roy had Lucario use its head appendages as weapons to bludgeon Medicham as a counterattack. In the midst of battle, Medicham reverted back to normal prematurely without fainting, due to the bond-breaking effects of using Laquium too many times in the past. Chalce reluctantly used Laquium on Medicham once more but despite that Medicham struggled to deal damage to its opponent. In the end, Lucario defeated Medicham with Aerial Ace, allowing Roy, Friede, and Ult to carry on to the center of Laqua. In [[HZ135]], Lucario was sent out to stop the Explorers from interfering in their attempts of erasing the Laquium once and for all. However, after Spinel merged with the Laquium Core and awakened it, Lucario tried to stop it, but was defeated and returned to its Poké Ball to rest. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Roy and Lucario Aura.png|thumb|left|250px|Lucario and Roy connecting through [[Aura]]]] This Lucario, distinct with its rare yellow [[Aura]]—a potential mark of its Shininess—forges a particularly strong bond with [[Roy]] through its sensitivity to Aura. More than just loyal, this Pokémon exhibits a remarkable battle readiness and has proven to be a formidable force, even capable of [[Mega Evolution]], making it a dependable asset in any challenge Roy faces. Lucario's ability to sense Aura has been helpful when predicting its opponents' next move, as seen in its battle against [[Ann]]'s {{p|Samurott}} in ''[[HZ091|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part Two)]]'' and the [[Laquium]]-afflicted {{p|Steelix}} in ''[[HZ092|Following Traces of Laquium]]''. [[File:Lucario Skeledirge Kilowattrel.png|thumb|250px|Lucario, {{TP|Roy|Skeledirge}}, and {{TP|Roy|Kilowattrel}}]] Lucario has a mostly stoic and serious personality, much like most of its {{p|Lucario|species}}. On occasion, it has shown to become exasperated by the antics of others, such as in ''[[HZ096|Crash! Team Dragon Rampage]]'', when Roy had to resort to it since [[Roy's Crocalor]] was too full to battle or when it saw [[Ult]] heading to the wrong direction. Due to it being caught after the disbandment of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]], it is not used to the eccentric antics of the younger members and their Pokémon and, as a result, tends to keep to itself in such moments, as seen in ''[[HZ093|Clash of the Nidothing Fans]]'', when it just stood by awkwardly as everyone added to Roy's song, seemingly confused and unsure of what to do. Despite this, Lucario is still capable of showing joy and affection, especially towards Roy and Skeledirge, and is perfectly capable of working alongside other Pokémon. Lucario, upon first being defeated by Roy's Crocalor in battle revealed a rarer and more adorable side of its personality, instantly begging Roy to have it join his team, showing keen admiration, excitement and respect towards stronger opponents. Lucario seems to have an interesting relationship with Ult's {{p|Sableye}} as the two of them often battle and work well together, especially when they Mega Evolve, likely due to them training together in [[Kalos]] alongside their Trainers. Also, like their Trainers, they can be at odds with each other and Lucario would tease Sableye, but does share a fist bump with the Darkness Pokémon after working together to win a battle. Although, as time passed, Lucario's friendship with Sableye has improved and don't seem to clash with each other than they used to. Despite always being ready to assist Roy in more serious situations, Lucario has also shown an eagerness for friendly battles as well, as shown in ''[[HZ091|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part Two)]]'' and ''[[HZ101|Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!]]''. In ''[[HZ105|Riding the Waves]]'', Lucario is shown to be a good swimmer and enjoys other activities such as surfing with Roy. Lucario appears to dislike sweets, as shown in ''[[HZ098|Reunion in Cortondo]]'', where it was the only Pokémon in the group not seen enjoying [[Katy]]'s confections. In [[HZ131]], it's revealed that Lucario becomes easily frustrated when its attacks do not work, becoming increasingly frustrated when [[Master Mayonnaise]]'s Mega {{p|Hawlucha}}'s defense caused its {{m|Close Combat}} to not do any damage. However, in the [[HZ132|next episode]], Lucario learned from its mistakes of getting frustrated and attacking head on with sheer brute force. Through that lesson, Lucario has calmed down more, strengthening its Aura and bond with its Trainer. width:auto" | [[File:HZ eyecatch Roy Crocalor Kilowattrel Lucario Captain Pikachu V2.png|x150px]] | style="{{roundy|5px}} border:2px solid #{{steel color dark}}; background: #{{steel color light}}; width:auto" | [[File:HZ eyecatch Roy Skeledirge Kilowattrel Lucario Captain Pikachu.png|x150px]] |} ==Trivia== [[File:Roy Lucario sparkling.png|thumb|250px|Like Shiny Pokémon in the games, Lucario sparkles as it exits its Poké Ball]] * Lucario is the first [[Shiny Pokémon]]: ** To appear in {{aniseries|HZ}} that is not a [[Legendary Pokémon]]. ** To appear in ''Pokémon Horizons: The Series'' that sparkles as it exits its [[Poké Ball]]. *** While other {{pkmn2|caught}} Shiny Pokémon, namely the [[Black Rayquaza]] and the [[White Zygarde]], had appeared before Lucario, they did not sparkle as they exited their Poké Balls until being recaught by [[Roy]] and [[Amethio]], respectively, in standard ones. * Lucario is currently the only Pokémon owned by Roy that has not {{Tera}}stallized. * Lucario is the first Pokémon in the {{pkmn|animated series}} to have [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] into different Mega Evolutions (Mega Lucario and Mega Lucario Z). * Lucario is currently the only one of its {{p|Lucario|species}} in the animated series to not have used any [[pulse move]]s. ==References== == Names == {{langtable|color={{fighting color light}}|bordercolor={{steel color dark}} |ja=イエローブラスト ''Yellow Blast'' |en=Yellow Flash |zh_yue=黃色疾風 ''{{tt|Wòhngsīk Jahtfūng|Yellow Gale}}'' |zh_cmn=黃色勁風 ''{{tt|Huángsè Jìngfēng|Yellow Gale}}'' }} {{-}} == Related articles == {{Animespecies|Lucario}} {{Roy's Pokémon|fighting|steel}} {{Anime Pokémon|fighting|steel}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Roy's Pokémon|Lucario]] [[Category:Shiny Pokémon]] [[Category:Nicknamed Pokémon]] [[Category:Recurring wild Pokémon|Lucario]] [[de:Rorys Lucario]] [[es:Lucario de Rod]] [[fr:Lucario de Rhod]] [[it:Lucario di Roy]] [[ja:ロイのルカリオ]] [[zh:罗伊的路卡利欧]]
